inputs.doc: E-023 EVAL: full-window rolled evaluation of the 222 km RING heads via ml/rollout_spatial.py, with e017_u1_s0 as the fatal validation gate. The pre-registered PRIMARY metric for E-023 is the rolled corridor AUC against the e017 3-seed band 0.5837 (seed sd 0.0047) — the training-time forecast objective already came back +3.9% better than baseline at 3 seeds (0.18476 vs 0.19216, -3.6 baseline sd, every ring seed below the baseline's minimum), which is the first arm all programme to move it. E-022 is the standing warning against reading that as a rollout result: its 3x3 was FLAT on the same forecast metric and 6.3 seed sd WORSE once rolled twelve months. Rolls all 84,405 window ocean pixels from 36 held-out-year starts, plus a 240-month hindcast from 2004-12. NO TRAINING: temporal_steps 0.
